thesis_triggers.event: Reviewed 2026-11-03: kept at $115. At $115 the pro forma claims (115 x ~340.6M incl. the 5.0M Cogentrix shares = $39.2B + ~$23.0B net debt + $2.49B preferred) are ~$64.6B, ~8.0x this build's FY2027 8.05B, at NRG's 8.08x (the cheapest IPP at 11-04 midday) and ~2.0x below the 10.01x median. The Texas pause is a new route to that multiple besides a PJM cap after 2029/30 and a weak 2027 guide: through the load drivers it costs ~$1.7/share at expected value, because the hedges carry FY2027-28 and the paused Batch Zero load (6.6 GW) is ~1.3 GW of ERCOT load by FY2029. Reaching $115 needs the market to price a PJM-state spread or a lasting Texas block (pause past ERCOT's 12-10 reports, AWS campus not energized) at ~8.0x: that is the thesis failing, not noise. Spot 118.61 sits ~3% above it (escalated). Original: At $115 the pro forma equity (115 x ~340.6M shares incl. the 5.0M Cogentrix shares = $39.2B) plus pro forma net debt (~$23.0B = 19.16 + 2.3 cash + 1.5 assumed debt) and $2.49B preferred is ~$64.6B, ~8.0x the $8.1B 2027 base (low end $7.4B + ~$0.7B deals). That is ~0.5x below NRG (8.5x at the 2026-10-23 close, NRG.ev_ebitda_ntm), the cheapest IPP, and ~1.3x below VST's own ~9.3x NTM standalone (estimate, 2026-10-23; was 0.9x and 1.8x at 10-14). Reaching it without a market-wide crash would mean a fundamental break: PJM moving to cap or administratively set 2030/31+ capacity prices (decision path after the end-2026 stakeholder review), or 2027 guidance on Nov 6 well below $8.1B. Between the agents' $112 and $118 (mean $114.6).

supervisor_summary: Round 2 converged: all five now use the $8.1B 2027 base, pre-SBC EBITDA like the peers, the full Cogentrix cost and the verified tax NPV, with fair values of $154-163 (mean $158.7). Two corrections remain: horizon claims are ~$22.9B when built from FCFbG guidance and the call's capital plan, and the DCFs sit 15-27% below the multiples mainly because 2.0% terminal growth re-prices the PJM risk the 9.5x multiple already carries. With 2.5% terminal growth my reconciled fair value is $166.0 (DCF $150.9, -12.5% vs the multiple; WACC 9.0% vs 8.4% implied), so I nudge the ladder up ~2 points at the centre with medium confidence. The PJM post-2029/30 cap flag is open, not tripped; thesis break $115.
